Couple of infra notes from my side:
- Data egress from Snowflake -> GCP for BQ would be the main cost and time driver. For our current size it's non-trivial but not blocker; expect 4–6 weeks of focused ETL work plus additional testing windows.
- Looker vs Metabase: Looker would give us finer governance (models/explores) which helps product analytics, but it requires LookML work and some centralization. Metabase is lighter but we've been hitting some concurrency/timeout issues on big ad-hoc queries.
- If we were to migrate, I recommend a hybrid plan: keep critical schemas on Snowflake for 6–9 months while backfilling historical data to BQ and moving new pipelines to the target. That reduces risk but increases short-term cost.

I'll estimate the engineering FTE effort and provide a more precise timeline if you want to present migration as a real option to leadership. For now, my bias: negotiate with Snowflake and get the performance/support guardrails, then decide by Q4 once we have clearer usage growth metrics.

—Dev
